bbs_physics.config.title: Physics
bbs_physics.config.general.title: General
bbs_physics.config.general.enabled-comme: The master switch of the physics engine. With it off, nothing is simulated and the addon costs nothing.
bbs_physics.config.general.debug-comment: Draws the shapes the simulation actually works with, on top of the rendered scene.
bbs_physics.config.general.collision_pre: Draws collision over the model in the form editor, so shapes can be placed by eye.
bbs_physics.forms.body.title: Body
bbs_physics.forms.body.authority_tooltip: 1 — the body follows its keyframes exactly and shoves everything aside. 0 — it is on its own. In between it is pulled towards the animation by that much: it lags, sags and gives way. Animate it from 1 down to 0 to let an object go.
bbs_physics.forms.body.shape_none: Nothing inside is marked up — this body falls through everything
bbs_physics.forms.body.shape_from: Shape gathered from what is inside: %s pieces
bbs_physics.forms.collision.title: Collision
bbs_physics.forms.collision.mode_tooltip: By default a bone collides with nothing. "Auto" measures its own cubes, "Shapes" uses the ones you place by hand.
bbs_physics.forms.collision.auto_thresho: Bones smaller than this (in blocks) are skipped. Fingers and straps only cost contacts and change nothing on screen.
bbs_physics.forms.collision.auto_mark_to: Sets "auto from cubes" on every bone above the threshold. Bones you placed shapes on by hand are left alone — this is a draft, not an answer.
bbs_physics.forms.collision.fit_tooltip: Puts one box the size of what the form draws into the form's own slot. A block is measured from its real outline; anything else gets a block-sized box to drag from.
bbs_physics.forms.collision.context.name: Preset name...
